hook: Koheda fruit market gets a *June 2, 2028* deadline
hook_b: Koheda fruit market gets a *June 2, 2028* deadline
tldr: Agriculture Minister Tummala Nageswara Rao set June 2, 2028 as the deadline for the Koheda Integrated Fruit Market.

beats.what: First phase by March 2027, full facility by Telangana Formation Day 2028; contract conditions to be changed.
beats.why: The minister reviewed construction progress at the Secretariat on Nov 12 and asked officials to speed up work.
beats.care: The market is meant to serve farmers; it is being built at Koheda on the city's edge.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: CM Revanth Reddy laid the foundation stone in June 2026.

cards.q: A 2028 deadline for the Koheda fruit market: realistic?

qs: What happens to traders at the current fruit market once Koheda opens?
How will farmers reach a market on the city's edge?

facts.t: BRS has alleged Koheda market land worth *₹3,000 crore* is under threat, Siasat reported.

watch: Phase one progress against the March 2027 target.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Koheda Fruit Market near Hyderabad set for 2028 completion

fact: Hyderabad's *239-acre* Koheda fruit market must be ready by June 2, 2028.
twist: Phase one is due even sooner, by *March 2027*, and a special officer, Rahul Raj, will track the work, per Siasat.
